process_area.title: Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design

value_stream.name: Field Sales, Outside Sales & Route-to-Market Force Management

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / Head of Trade / Account Management / Commercial Leadership
fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Key Accounts (VS-107), Trade-Pro (VS-43), Strategy (VS-33), Merchandising (VS-01)
fields.Trigger: B2B-growth strategy; coverage review; competitive pressure
fields.Volume: Enterprise field-sales strategy (~40% B2B revenue; ~5,200 trade + ~200 corporate accounts)

Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: field-sales strategy approved; aligned to B2B strategy (VS-33); channel conflict managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-11/VS-10 (B2B/digital), VS-107 (key accounts), VS-46 (B2G), W4222 (channel assignment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Coverage-gap risk**: High-value accounts uncovered; mitigated by segment-based coverage model
- **Channel-conflict risk**: Field vs digital vs store overlap on the same account; mitigated by clear channel assignment (W4222)
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); B2B/portal (VS-11/VS-10); key accounts (VS-107); trade-pro (VS-43); B2G (VS-46); merchandising (VS-01)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / COO
steps.activity: Field Sales define the go-to-coverage model — which B2B segments/projects are covered by field reps (high-value/strategic) vs digital/self-service (VS-10/VS-11 portal) vs store (VS-07) — aligned to B2B strategy (VS-33)

Field Sales define the field-sales value proposition and selling motion (consultative/spec selling, project pursuit, account farming vs new-logo hunting), and the segment focus (trade, corporate, B2G links to VS-46)
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / Trade Sales / Key Accounts

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / COO
steps.activity: Field Sales document the strategy, obtain approval, resource it (W4218), and cascade to territory/account/coverage plans (W4219–W4221)

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / HR (VS-19) / Workforce Planning (VS-103.3)
fields.Volume: Field-sales headcount sized to ~5,400 B2B accounts + prospects

Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: force sizing workload-justified; business case approved (Finance/COO)
Cross-references: - links to VS-103.3 (workforce planning), VS-19/VS-121 (HR/recruitment), VS-102 (comp), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-70 (specialist spec)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-sizing risk**: Too few reps → uncovered accounts/low call-frequency; mitigated by workload-based sizing
- **Over-sizing risk**: Too many reps → cost without return; mitigated by business-case discipline
System Touchpoints: - Workforce planning (VS-103.3); HR (VS-19); compensation (VS-102); recruitment (VS-121/VS-19.1); finance (VS-17.4)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CHRO
steps.activity: Field Sales/HR size the force (workload-based: accounts × call-frequency × call-duration; capacity model), and structure roles (outside sales rep, trade-account exec, project/spec specialist, sales engineer)
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / HR / Workforce Planning

steps.activity: Field Sales/HR design role profiles, spans of control, reporting lines, and specialist roles (e.g., solar/renewable spec links to VS-70, electrical/plumbing spec), aligned to coverage (W4220)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CFO
steps.activity: Field Sales/Finance build the force business case (cost vs incremental B2B revenue), obtain approval, and sequence hiring with recruitment (VS-121/VS-19.1)

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / Sales Operations
fields.Participants: Regional Sales Managers, Key Accounts (VS-107), Trade-Pro (VS-43), Analytics (VS-28)
fields.Trigger: Force structure (W4218); account growth; rebalance cycle

Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: territories workload-balanced; assignments complete & audited; disputes managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-11/VS-107 (CRM/accounts), VS-136 (regions), VS-07 (store regions), W4232 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Imbalance risk**: Some territories overloaded, others light; mitigated by workload-balanced design + equity monitoring
- **Orphan-account risk**: Accounts unassigned; mitigated by complete assignment + audits
System Touchpoints: - Territory-modeling tool; analytics (VS-28); CRM/account assignment (VS-11/VS-107); network regions (VS-136)

steps.activity: Sales Ops/Analytics design territories balancing workload (account count, revenue potential, geography/travel, project density) via territory-modeling, aligned to store/DC regions (VS-07/VS-136)
Sales Ops assign accounts to territories/reps, handle overlaps (multi-territory corporate accounts links to VS-107), and document territory boundaries
Sales Ops rebalance on growth/reorg, manage territory-change communications/disputes, and monitor territory equity (W4232)

Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: segmentation potential-based; coverage plan documented; adherence monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-126 (CDP), VS-11/VS-107 (CRM/tier), VS-28 (analytics), W4222 (channel), W4232 (adherence)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-tier risk**: High-potential account under-covered; mitigated by potential-based segmentation
- **Coverage-drift risk**: Actual call-frequency ≠ plan; mitigated by coverage-adherence monitoring (W4232)
System Touchpoints: - CDP (VS-126); CRM/account tier (VS-11/VS-107); analytics (VS-28); B2B portal (VS-11)

steps.activity: Sales Ops/Analytics segment and tier accounts (by revenue, potential, strategic value, project pipeline) — e.g., strategic (named, VS-107) / key / growth / maintenance / digital-only — using CDP (VS-126)
Sales Ops define the coverage plan per tier (call-frequency, channel, contact-owner) — strategic/key via field rep, growth via rep+digital, maintenance/digital via portal (VS-11) — aligned to W4222
Sales Ops assign accounts to coverage, manage tier movements (promotion/demotion), and monitor coverage adherence (W4232)

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), Comp (VS-102), Regional Mgrs, Trade Sales (VS-11)
fields.Volume: Quotas per field rep × territory × product line

Automation Opportunity: - Quota-modeling/scenario tools; attainment-tracking automation; fairness analytics
Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: quotas validated bottom-up; incentive fairness-tested; margin-aware
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4/VS-101 (revenue plan), VS-102.3 (comp/incentive), VS-33 (strategy), VS-11 (CRM), W4233 (attainment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sandbagging/stretch risk**: Quotas too easy/impossible; mitigated by bottom-up validation + potential-based
- **Mis-incent risk**: Quota drives wrong behavior (e.g., discount to hit volume); mitigated by margin-aware incentive design
System Touchpoints: - Finance/revenue plan (VS-17.4/VS-101); comp (VS-102.3); CRM attainment (VS-11); analytics (VS-28)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CFO
steps.activity: Sales Ops/Finance set territory/rep quotas from the B2B revenue plan (VS-33/VS-101 MFP), account potential (W4220), and historical performance, with bottom-up validation by regional managers
Sales Ops/Comp design the incentive link (quota attainment → comp, links to VS-102.3 variable pay), test for fairness/attainability, and align to capacity (W4218)
Sales Ops cascade quotas to reps, manage quarterly adjustments (market shift, territory change), and track attainment (W4233)

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / Commercial Operations
fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Digital (VS-10), Store Ops (VS-07), Key Accounts (VS-107)
fields.Trigger: Coverage model (W4217); channel strategy; account need

workflows.name: Route-to-Market & Channel Assignment (Field vs Digital vs Store)

Automation Opportunity: - Channel-mix analytics; digital-readiness scoring (VS-126); auto-reassignment rules
Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: channel-interaction rules prevent conflict; accounts RTM-assigned by segment; single-customer-view (VS-126)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (B2B/portal), VS-10 (digital), VS-07 (store), VS-126 (single customer view), W4220 (segmentation), W4232 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-conflict risk**: Field and digital/store compete for the same sale/credit; mitigated by interaction rules + single-customer-view
- **Mis-assignment risk**: Low-value accounts burning field time; mitigated by segment-based RTM
System Touchpoints: - B2B portal (VS-11); digital (VS-10); store (VS-07); CDP/single-customer-view (VS-126); CRM (VS-11)
Time Estimate: - ~2 weeks annual RTM design; ongoing reallocation

steps.activity: Field Sales/Commercial define the route-to-market per segment (field rep, digital/self-service portal VS-11, store VS-07, phone/inside-sales, partner), and the channel-assignment rules
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / Commercial Ops

steps.activity: Field Sales define channel-interaction rules (who leads on a multi-channel account, lead handoff field↔digital↔store), and prevent conflict (links to VS-126 single customer view)
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / Trade Sales / Digital

steps.activity: Field Sales assign accounts to RTM, monitor channel mix/effectiveness (W4232), and reallocate as behavior shifts (e.g., digital-ready accounts moved to portal)

fields.Owner: Field Sales Enablement Lead / Sales Enablement (VS-124) / L&D (VS-19.4)
fields.Participants: L&D (VS-19.4), Sales Enablement (VS-124), Merchandising (VS-01), Trade Specialists
fields.Trigger: New hire (VS-121/VS-19.1); ongoing enablement; product launch

Automation Opportunity: - Onboarding/learning paths; certification tracking; product-knowledge refresh automation
Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: onboarding structured; reps certified before independent coverage; ABC trained (VS-86.3)
Cross-references: - links to VS-124 (sales enablement), VS-19.4 (L&D), VS-121/VS-19.1 (recruitment), VS-01/VS-137 (product), VS-33.3 (competitive intel), VS-86.3 (ABC)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ramp-slow risk**: New reps slow to productivity; mitigated by structured onboarding + certification
- **Skill-gap risk**: Reps lack spec/technical depth; mitigated by category certification & specialist support
System Touchpoints: - L&D (VS-19.4); sales enablement (VS-124); product knowledge (VS-01/VS-137); competitive intel (VS-33.3)

steps.activity: Enablement run structured onboarding for new field reps (product knowledge, consultative/spec selling, estimating/quoting, CRM/tools, compliance ABC links to VS-86.3), building on VS-124
Enablement/Merchandising run ongoing enablement (new products VS-01.1, spec/technical updates, competitive intel VS-33.3, selling skills VS-124), and certify reps on categories/specialties
Enablement measure rep competency/certification, coach underperformers (links to VS-124, VS-103), and refresh on market/product change
steps.r: Field Sales Enablement Lead / Regional Mgrs

fields.Owner: Field Sales Ops / Sales Technology / IT (VS-27) / EA (VS-113)
fields.Volume: Field-sales tooling for the whole force (mobile CRM, route, quoting, content)

workflows.name: Field Sales Tooling, CRM & Mobility Platform

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile CRM with offline sync; auto route/call planning; in-flow quoting/order entry
Controls: - CTL-650 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Strategy, Territory & Force Design (PA-140.1).)
- CTL-650: tooling security/privacy assessed (VS-27.3/VS-91); adoption monitored; cost governed (VS-135)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (CRM/ERP), VS-126 (CDP), VS-137 (PIM/content), VS-27.3 (security), VS-135 (TBM), VS-113 (EA), VS-10 (digital)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adoption risk**: Reps don't use CRM/tools → poor data; mitigated by usability, training, and workflow-embedded use
- **Offline/reliability risk**: Field reps lose connectivity; mitigated by mobile/offline capability
System Touchpoints: - Mobile CRM (VS-11); CDP (VS-126); PIM/content (VS-137); ERP/order (VS-11/VS-16); security (VS-27.3); TBM (VS-135); EA (VS-113)

steps.activity: Sales Tech/EA/IT define the field-sales tooling stack (mobile CRM, route/call planning, estimating/quoting, product/content access VS-137, order entry VS-11), and the mobile/offline requirements
Sales Tech/IT deploy and integrate the stack (CRM↔ERP↔CDP↔PIM, mobile/offline, security VS-27.3), and train reps (W4223)
Sales Tech/IT govern the platform lifecycle (roadmap, adoption, cost via VS-135 TBM, data quality), and optimize based on rep feedback/analytics (W4232)
